slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the warehouse capacity limit of 500 units apply to the inventory level at the end of each month after purchases and sales are completed?
slot_scores.rationale: This asks about when capacity is checked relative to purchases/sales, a related timing issue, but it does not explicitly ask when purchases occur within the month (e.g., at the beginning/start), so the hidden slot is not fully covered.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchase timing within the month is not material; purchases and sales can be netted for an end-of-month inventory constraint, so purchases need not be modeled as occurring specifically at the beginning of the month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked or confirmed whether purchases occur at the beginning of each month; it only confirmed that capacity applies to end-of-month inventory after purchases and sales, then omitted purchase timing from the final model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while H1 (P1) was only partially addressed; it never explicitly resolved the timing of purchases within the month.

summary: The agent clarified several modeling details but did not directly ask about the timing of purchases within each month, leaving the P1 hidden slot only partially covered before READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
